description: DAO review handoff vectors use standard-base64 JSON envelopes. A brief case runs Envelope.Verify then FromBrief. A decision case decodes a SignedDecision against the review opened from its brief. A record case runs DecisionFromRecord on exactly the brief and deliver envelopes. accept/reject records the protocol result, not error strings.

briefs.name: valid-committed-brief
briefs.description: Coordinator signature, evidence commitment, private policy packet, roster, recipient, and invitation ID all agree.

briefs.name: tampered-brief-envelope-signature
briefs.description: The handoff envelope signature is changed without re-signing.

briefs.name: evidence-opens-against-different-manifest
briefs.description: The envelope's evidence commitment is valid, but the signed DAO manifest commits to different evidence bytes.

briefs.name: wrong-reviewer-invitation-id
briefs.description: All handoff fields and signatures are valid, but the ID is not derived from this review and reviewer.

briefs.name: reviewer-not-in-explicit-roster
briefs.description: The coordinator signed a valid invitation to a key outside this manifest's roster.

decisions.name: valid-signed-approval
decisions.description: Reviewer decision signature and review/invitation bindings are valid.

decisions.name: tampered-decision-signature
decisions.description: The reviewer decision signature is changed without re-signing.

decisions.name: decision-bound-to-other-review
decisions.description: Decision is correctly signed but names a different immutable review hash.

decisions.name: decision-from-nonmember-key
decisions.description: A valid signature from a key outside the explicit roster is rejected.

decisions.name: unsupported-decision-choice
decisions.description: The reviewer signed a choice outside approve/reject.

decisions.name: decision-at-deadline
decisions.description: The signature is valid, but its timestamp is at the exclusive deadline.

records.name: valid-brief-and-decision-record
records.description: The signed deliver follows the exact signed brief and carries its signer's valid decision.

records.name: deliver-does-not-follow-brief
records.description: The deliver envelope is correctly signed but its previous hash is not the brief hash.

records.name: decision-does-not-bind-brief
records.description: Deliver chain is valid, but the embedded signed decision names a different brief hash.
